content:
We have a new release candidate out: v4.23.0-rc2. (Recall that we have moved the release cycle to mid-month.)

Please see the release notes for full details.

As usual Mathlib, doc-gen4, verso, Batteries, Aesop, and the REPL are available using this toolchain using the v4.23.0-rc2 tag at the respective repositories (and ProofWidgets at v0.0.71). We encourage all projects downstream of these to update when possible (and to release their own v4.23.0-rc2 after updating).

This release has lots of under-the-hood improvements, and many bug fixes. We'd like to highlight the benchmarking results for the commit that moved Mathlib to v4.23.0-rc2, which is a sea of green (including a 15% instruction count reduction overall).
Discussion of this release will take place at #general > v4.23.0 .
